objective: Implement a local-only Project Intelligence watch mode that refreshes project-intelligence snapshots and agent context exports on bounded docs/code/autopilot file changes with debounce, failure status, redaction, and graceful manual stop behavior.
acceptance: Add a local CLI script such as pnpm project:intelligence:watch.
Watch only bounded docs/code/autopilot source-of-truth paths and ignore generated artifacts, dependencies, dist outputs, cache, secrets, and git metadata.
Debounce file events with a default 1500 ms window and coalesce bursts into deterministic refresh cycles.
Refresh project-intelligence-snapshot artifacts before project-intelligence-agent-context artifacts.
Record sanitized watch status without deleting last successful artifacts after refresh failures.
Support graceful foreground stop with Ctrl+C and no daemon, launch agent, telemetry, hosted dashboard, deployment, or target repo writes.
